description: Millions of folks are about to get snowed in. Stay safe. Here’s a code for last year’s Thriving with AI course on Udemy. It’s free for the first 1,000 people. And I see that This is Marketing is currently half-price on Amazon. Or you could build a snowman.
title: Blizzard pasttimes
